flashcard_questions.q: Which phrase does Lady Macduff use to accuse her husband of lacking instinct?
How does Macduff’s son say he will live without a father?
Which insult does the murderer throw at Macduff’s son before killing him?
What does the wren represent in Lady Macduff’s bird image?
flashcard_questions.a: The small and vulnerable — Macduff’s defenceless family.

flashcard_questions.q: Which bird represents Macbeth as a nocturnal predator across the play?
Which royal bird is killed by a mousing owl in Act Two, Scene Four?
Which name does Macduff give Macbeth when he hears of the massacre?
What does ‘fell swoop’ mean in Macduff’s speech of grief?
flashcard_questions.a: A fierce, sudden attack by a bird of prey.

flashcard_questions.q: Why does Malcolm pretend to be worse than Macbeth?
flashcard_questions.a: To test whether Macduff is a true patriot or Macbeth’s spy.

flashcard_questions.q: What is anaphora in a speech?
flashcard_questions.a: The repetition of a word at the start of successive clauses, for emphasis.

flashcard_questions.q: Which word does Macduff repeat to open each clause about Scotland’s suffering?
What does the yoke image say about Scotland under Macbeth?
flashcard_questions.a: It is enslaved and treated like an animal in harness.

flashcard_questions.q: Which euphemism does Ross use to say Macduff’s family are dead?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘They were well at peace when I did leave ’em.’

flashcard_questions.q: Which animal does Malcolm compare himself to while testing Macduff?
Which line shows Macduff redefining what it means to be a man?
flashcard_questions.a: ‘I must also feel it as a man.’

notes: 15 cards: 6 quotation-recall fronts, 4 image-to-meaning (the wren, the yoke, ‘fell swoop’, the lamb), 3 bird-motif identification (owl, falcon, hell-kite), 1 term-to-definition (anaphora), 1 character-motive card (Malcolm’s test). The existing wren card was flipped to symbol-to-meaning so it is not repeated. ‘Dramatic irony’, ‘motif’ and ‘kingship’ dropped as glossary restatements; the twelve king-becoming graces were left out because any card would be an enumeration. All quotations verbatim from the lesson content.
